verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a web-dashboard compliance SaaS. The evidence shows some programmatic surface: custom integration push APIs and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, plus inbound webhooks that trigger ingestion workflows. These could be driven from scripts or pipelines without the UI. Separately, an open-source skills package (installed via npx) runs compliance and PII checks inside coding-agent workflows, but nothing shows the platform itself running headlessly or in CI. Missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline gating), a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), auth/token docs for automation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
